name: fig37_scrambling_otoc_entanglement
caption: Haar-random two-qubit brickwork circuits. (a) The OTOC F = Re Tr[W(t)^dag V^dag W(t) V]/d between Z on site 0 and Z at the stated distance stays at 1 until the operator front arrives and then decays toward ~0 (mean over 24 circuits, bands +/- 2 s.e.m.). (b) The arrival layer grows linearly with distance, a discrete light cone (open boundary conditions, so edge effects exist). (c) Half-chain entanglement from a product state saturates at 3.650 +/- 0.002 versus the Page value 3.659. Exact state-vector calculations; small sizes only.
